sources.note: Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. It publishes the unit's coordinates, its declared production and the contact route the producer entered; entries carry no date and no review. Declares lamb rearing and a vegetable garden in the market-garden belt of Anguil, with the holder's email.
